contracts.reason: The frozen runtime applies movement, damage, status and turn effects imperatively across controllers and SkillGraph executors; it has no immutable command-to-state-plus-events boundary to link as an exact Oracle.
invariants: a rejected command preserves source state and emits one stable rejection event
successful state is complete before ordered presentation events are consumed

frozenEvidence.observation: move executor awaits mutable MoveCommand execution and marks ability use
turn advancement delegates directly into the mutable grid controller

contracts.reason: The frozen project mixes Unity global Random, unseeded static System.Random and Guid ordering, so no single serializable Unity RNG state exists to preserve for deterministic replay.
invariants: random state is explicit and serializable
the algorithm ID is stored with Golden and save schemas
all gameplay draws advance only the supplied stream
algorithm changes require an explicit schema migration
